text:
Aaron Fordham: Morning everyone! Aaron here — new on platform team. First day 🙌. Laptop arrived, I'm on Wi-Fi but VPN keeps failing with 'auth timeout'. Anyone point me to who handles MDM/VPN? Also curious what the team's snack/lunch rotation is — lunch plan? :bento:

Mira Chen: welcome! ping @IT Support for VPN, or try this quick command if you're using the CLI client: `sudo openconnect --protocol=anyconnect vpn.redwood.com` — but better to enroll via MDM. If you don't see the MDM prompt DM me and I'll resend the invite.

Samir Patel: hey Aaron — I'm your onboarding buddy. Slack huddle later at 2pm? Also adding you to #platform-alerts. :thumbsup:

DevOps Bot: welcome message logged for Aaron Fordham. Onboarding checklist: laptop_enrolled, vpn_access, repo_access — status: laptop_enrolled ✅, vpn_access ❌, repo_access pending.

Jess Ramos: @IT Support I can help if needed. Aaron, try the VPN troubleshooting steps: 1) reboot, 2) check latest MDM profile in SelfService app, 3) clear cached certs: ```sudo rm /etc/ssl/certs/vpn-*``` then retry.

IT Support: Hi Aaron — we just pushed your device enrollment invite to the email on file. Resend? If you didn't get it, reply with the personal email you used for onboarding. Also confirm macOS version.

Aaron Fordham: Thanks all — macOS 13.5. I'll try Mira's tip and reboot now. @Samir yep 2pm huddle sounds good. Re: lunch — I'm vegetarian, down for ramen or salad :)

HR Bot: Welcome to Redwood Inference! Orientation at 10am in #all-hands, please fill the form: https://redwood.inference/onboarding/form

Samir Patel: quick heads up — team lunches Thurs. We usually order and split. Also we do a 15-min "show-and-tell" Friday — share a fun fact or a tiny demo.

Aaron Fordham: Fun fact — I used to compete in rock balancing competitions. Photos incoming 📸

Mira Chen: love it. See you at 2pm — DMed you a link to the MDM guide and the SelfService app URL.

Jess Ramos: If VPN still fails after those steps, file a ticket and tag me @Jess Ramos — I have admin access and can push the cert manually.

DevOps Bot: ticket 7892 created for vpn_auth_timeout by Aaron Fordham. Assigned to IT Support.

IT Support: Ticket noted. ETA ~45min. We'll update the ticket and ping this thread when resolved.

Aaron Fordham: Awesome — thanks everyone! Appreciate the warm welcome.
